en: Job 18

p.src: 1  Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,

en: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,
u.src: 1  Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,

p.src: 2  “How long will you hunt for words? Consider, and afterwards we will speak.

en: “How long will you hunt for words? Consider, and afterwards we will speak.
u.src: 2  “How long will you hunt for words? Consider, and afterwards we will speak.

p.src: 3  Why are we counted as animals, which have become unclean in your sight?

en: Why are we counted as animals, which have become unclean in your sight?
u.src: 3  Why are we counted as animals, which have become unclean in your sight?

p.src: 4  You who tear yourself in your anger, will the earth be forsaken for you? Or will the rock be removed out of its place?

en: You who tear yourself in your anger, will the earth be forsaken for you? Or will the rock be removed out of its place?
u.src: 4  You who tear yourself in your anger, will the earth be forsaken for you? Or will the rock be removed out of its place?

p.src: 5  “Yes, the light of the wicked will be put out. The spark of his fire won’t shine.

en: “Yes, the light of the wicked will be put out. The spark of his fire won’t shine.
u.src: 5  “Yes, the light of the wicked will be put out. The spark of his fire won’t shine.

p.src: 6  The light will be dark in his tent. His lamp above him will be put out.

en: The light will be dark in his tent. His lamp above him will be put out.
u.src: 6  The light will be dark in his tent. His lamp above him will be put out.

p.src: 7  The steps of his strength will be shortened. His own counsel will cast him down.

en: The steps of his strength will be shortened. His own counsel will cast him down.
u.src: 7  The steps of his strength will be shortened. His own counsel will cast him down.

p.src: 8  For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he wanders into its mesh.

en: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he wanders into its mesh.
u.src: 8  For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he wanders into its mesh.

p.src: 9  A snare will take him by the heel. A trap will catch him.

en: A snare will take him by the heel. A trap will catch him.
u.src: 9  A snare will take him by the heel. A trap will catch him.

p.src: 10  A noose is hidden for him in the ground, a trap for him on the path.

en: A noose is hidden for him in the ground, a trap for him on the path.
u.src: 10  A noose is hidden for him in the ground, a trap for him on the path.

p.src: 11  Terrors will make him afraid on every side, and will chase him at his heels.

en: Terrors will make him afraid on every side, and will chase him at his heels.
u.src: 11  Terrors will make him afraid on every side, and will chase him at his heels.

p.src: 12  His strength will be famished. Calamity will be ready at his side.

en: His strength will be famished. Calamity will be ready at his side.
u.src: 12  His strength will be famished. Calamity will be ready at his side.

p.src: 13  The members of his body will be devoured. The firstborn of death will devour his members.

en: The members of his body will be devoured. The firstborn of death will devour his members.
u.src: 13  The members of his body will be devoured. The firstborn of death will devour his members.

p.src: 14  He will be rooted out of the security of his tent. He will be brought to the king of terrors.

en: He will be rooted out of the security of his tent. He will be brought to the king of terrors.
u.src: 14  He will be rooted out of the security of his tent. He will be brought to the king of terrors.

p.src: 15  There will dwell in his tent that which is none of his. Sulfur will be scattered on his habitation.

en: There will dwell in his tent that which is none of his. Sulfur will be scattered on his habitation.
u.src: 15  There will dwell in his tent that which is none of his. Sulfur will be scattered on his habitation.

p.src: 16  His roots will be dried up beneath. His branch will be cut off above.

en: His roots will be dried up beneath. His branch will be cut off above.
u.src: 16  His roots will be dried up beneath. His branch will be cut off above.

p.src: 17  His memory will perish from the earth. He will have no name in the street.

en: His memory will perish from the earth. He will have no name in the street.
u.src: 17  His memory will perish from the earth. He will have no name in the street.

p.src: 18  He will be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.

en: He will be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.
u.src: 18  He will be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.

p.src: 19  He will have neither son nor grandson among his people, nor any remaining where he lived.

en: He will have neither son nor grandson among his people, nor any remaining where he lived.
u.src: 19  He will have neither son nor grandson among his people, nor any remaining where he lived.

p.src: 20  Those who come after will be astonished at his day, as those who went before were frightened.

en: Those who come after will be astonished at his day, as those who went before were frightened.
u.src: 20  Those who come after will be astonished at his day, as those who went before were frightened.

p.src: 21  Surely such are the dwellings of the unrighteous. This is the place of him who doesn’t know God.”

en: Surely such are the dwellings of the unrighteous. This is the place of him who doesn’t know God.”
u.src: 21  Surely such are the dwellings of the unrighteous. This is the place of him who doesn’t know God.”
